title: 利率5.5%：权益资产还能继续走强吗？，盈利撑住，估值反而回落
speaker: Jeannie

segments.en: I guess on the point of higher yields and higher rates, you know, can equity markets continue to rally amidst now 5.5% rates?
segments.zh: 说到更高的收益率和利率，在目前5.5%的利率环境下，权益市场还能继续走强吗？

segments.en: Yeah. So, you know, our view from a city-weld CIO perspective is short answer, yes. The increase that we've seen in rates has been a confluence of a whole bunch of things, right?
segments.zh: 从花旗资管首席投资官团队的角度看，简短回答是：可以。利率上行是多重因素共同作用的结果。

segments.en: When you think about, there's definitely inflationary pressures, though interestingly, the rise in US tenure has not actually been a huge increase in inflation expectations, it's actually been driven by real rates.
segments.zh: 确实存在通胀压力，但有趣的是，美国长期利率上行并非主要来自通胀预期，而是由实际利率推动。

segments.en: Now, a component of that is some of the concerns around fiscal discipline and budgets, but a lot of it is also just a reflection of good growth in the United States, and you're seeing that in different pockets of the world as well.
segments.zh: 其中一部分来自对财政纪律和预算的担忧，但很大程度上也反映了美国增长良好，全球其他地区也有类似表现。

segments.en: You know, for us, that good growth, inflation, kind of all leads to a really, really solid earnings picture, and that has been the predominant driver for equity markets this year.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，良好增长加上通胀，带来了相当扎实的盈利图景，这也是今年权益市场的主要驱动力。

segments.en: When you break down equity returns, the vast majority of it has been driven by earnings growth and not by multiple expansion, if anything, key e-multiples have actually come down this year.
segments.zh: 拆解权益回报来看，绝大部分来自盈利增长，而非估值扩张，实际上今年关键估值倍数还有所回落。

segments.en: It's true across the globe, it's not just a US story, where global markets are across different regions and different countries, and it's because earnings growth is outpacing the pace of price return.
segments.zh: 这不仅是美国的现象，全球不同地区和国家都是如此，因为盈利增长快于价格回报。

segments.en: And so we're actually seeing kind of like a good normalization, a little bit of a breather, if you will, as it relates to valuations, you're seeing some of the higher yield impact there,
segments.zh: 所以估值层面其实是一种良性正常化，甚至可以说是稍作喘息，也能看到更高收益率带来的影响。

segments.en: but it's not overcoming any of what we're seeing in terms of fundamental strength.
segments.zh: 但这并没有压过我们所看到的基本面韧性。
